fact: The output of Design is an approved implementation taskbook.
Designer is the subagent assigned to produce and assess design proposals.
A Designer Group consists of a lead Designer and two member Designers.
Lead Designer owns the version of the design taskbook sent to Implementer and coordinates resolution of Review findings.
Member Designer contributes an independent design and reviews approved plans or implementation within the Designer Group.
The plugin retains Designer identities and sessions from Design through Review.
